name: pumprint
description: Pumprint: six open-source trench tools on one website (Kolibri Search, Moth Radar, Chameleonscope, Loxley on paper, Canary, Fomo Radar), with a 3D fingerprint you can shatter.

scripts.build:samples: node scripts/build-fomo-archive.mjs && node scripts/build-fomo-sample.mjs && node scripts/build-chameleon-sample.mjs && node scripts/build-canary-sample.mjs && node scripts/build-loxley-sample.mjs
